transformations.description: Uses the complete numeric GTFS stop_id/operator idparada as the stable Murcia StopNode suffix and creates a same-code singleton StopPlace for each new identity.
Serializes the frozen unique ordered GTFS stop sequence for main public routes C5 (28 stops) and R17 (48 stops) exactly; both patterns have closesLoop false and no reverse pattern is inferred.
Excludes Cocheras/Cabecera route records from passenger topology under the owner-approved frozen citywide architecture while preserving them in source/provenance artifacts.
Reuses the already accepted canonical es-murcia identity fields exactly and computes only this package local center/bounds from the 67 routed StopPlace coordinates with deterministic framing padding.
Adds exactly one catalog descriptor and recomputes asset and aggregate SHA-256 values from final serialized bytes.

warnings: The archived GTFS is a Transitous processed mirror of the official NAP Transportes de Murcia feed; byte identity with the original NAP ZIP is not claimed.
All 67 component coordinates are either exact accepted Grade A objects (19 reused identities) or Grade B structured GTFS values (48 new identities); no coordinates are inferred or interpolated.
StopNode.sourceReferences is empty because no genuine OpenStreetMap platform or stop_position object was reconciled.

Nineteen target stop identities are exact-copied from previously accepted Murcia components and 48 identities are newly created. Later Murcia components must reuse all accepted Murcia StopNode and StopPlace objects exactly when IDs recur.
All 67 target stops are assigned to the already accepted es-murcia settlement; no cross-municipal evidence occurs in the C5/R17 component.
A later original NAP download is a provenance/source-custody upgrade only; accepted identities must not be silently reconstructed unless an explicit migration is authorized.
